title: Create a communication entry for a componentized popup window
remarks.text.0:
Returns an IDesignPortal object, used by extensions in conjunction with the VirtualRender / virtual machine component of lc-editor-design-react.
All communication (sending messages + receiving events) is encapsulated inside the object.
